STYLE (apply to every image):
Dark-xianxia pixel art, isometric RPG, overbearing and dominant "heaven-defying" presence.
The spirit (martial soul) is a colossal, menacing power towering behind or beside a small figure.
Angular, jagged, ASYMMETRIC silhouette; large readable shape that stays recognizable when shrunk to 32x32.
Muted dark-ink (shuimo) palette: deep shadow regions, desaturated dark base colors, and only a FEW small
high-contrast glowing accents (eyes, core, blade edge, talisman lines). 3 tones per color region
(shadow, base, highlight), one extra bright tone only for metal and glow. Dark outline #1a1020, 1 px,
no anti-aliasing, hard pixel edges. Light comes from the upper left.
Cultivation (xianxia) flavor: use ONLY the motifs listed in the SPIRIT section below (typically 2-3);
do not add any other motif (no extra halos, storm clouds, formation circles or lightning unless listed).
Materials shown by texture, never by glossy shine: broken scales, chipped metal, jade with cloudy core.
Calm, cold, lethal expression. Heavy, ancient, sacred-and-dangerous mood.
Transparent background. No UI frame. Do not draw the glow as a soft blur: paint only hard-edged pixels
(glow, particles and motion are added in code).

NEGATIVE (forbidden):
cute, kawaii, chibi, adorable, baby, big round shiny eyes, rosy cheeks, smiling, friendly, mascot, cartoon,
Saturday-morning cartoon, toy, plastic, rubber, figurine, glossy, soft rounded bubble shapes,
pastel, candy colors, rainbow gradient, neon-bright flat color over the whole body,
flat plain featureless weapon, anime sparkle stars, hearts, bubbles, emoji, sticker, game-mobile gacha look,
readable text, letters, logo, watermark, signature, UI frame, card border, human character in the spirit image,
3D render, photorealistic, blurry, smooth gradients, soft shadows, noise, dithering haze,
anti-aliasing, painterly brush texture, drawing a copy of existing sprite.

ADDITIONAL FORBIDDEN (this asset type): tiny whole animal, full body, frame, card, text, background scenery.

SPIRIT: Xúc Xích (xuc_xich). The design brief below comes from the canonical design table and is written in Vietnamese: follow it exactly, keep every hex code as written, and use only the motifs listed in it (do not add any other motif).
- Overbearing presence: **Thánh Quang Hương Tràng**: bản đặc tả cũ giữ chất hài (xúc xích nướng); bản v2 **bá đạo hóa thành pháp bảo**: một cây "đại hương tràng" khổng lồ nứt vỏ, tỏa kim quang như thần khí, hài chỉ còn là chi tiết tinh tế (vỏ nứt nướng, hơi nóng). **Cần chủ repo duyệt riêng con này.**
- Form: trụ dài chếch như một cây trượng / lệnh, đầu bo nhưng có gờ, vỏ nứt, có khắc đai.
- Palette: nâu cam đậm theo `robe`, ánh nướng cam theo `col`; nhấn vàng kim ở vết nứt + đỏ thẫm ở đai.
- Motifs (use only these): kim quang thánh khí từ vết nứt, vòng ấn hương, hơi nóng thành khí cuộn.
- Companion objects: vài hương tràng nhỏ bay quanh như pháp bảo; hơi bốc (code).
- Base colors in the game data: accent (col) #e8875a, body (robe) #6a3a22.

ASSET TYPE: spirit icon source for a menu icon (final art 32x32 and 24x24). Square 1:1 image. ONE emblem: the single most identifying shape of the spirit (head, blade, hammer head, flower, flame core...), centered, filling about 80% of the frame, strong silhouette, 2 or 3 flat tones plus one bright accent. No scenery, no full-body animal, no motif other than the one that defines the silhouette.

BACKGROUND: transparent (real alpha). If your tool cannot output alpha, use one flat solid #FF00FF magenta, with no gradient, no texture, no shadow.

LOOK (this replaces any request for a pixel grid, pixel count or color limit): chunky low-resolution pixel look, flat color clusters, simple shapes readable when shrunk. Large deliberate clusters of flat color with hard square edges; few broad color regions; no microtexture, no fine hatching, no tiny decorative marks, no fur or feather strands, no noise. Do not try to count pixels or colors: a post-processing tool converts your image to the final pixel grid and palette, so give it bold, simple shapes.

STYLE REFERENCE: image 1 (attached) is an APPROVED image of this project's new art direction. Match only its line weight, how few and how large its color clusters are, and its overall mood. Do not copy its subject, pose, composition or any detail of it.
